```{python}
import pandas as pd

# 1. Load data
url = "https://orca.casa.ucl.ac.uk/~jreades/data/20260619-London-listings.csv.gz"

bnb = pd.read_csv(
    url,
    compression="gzip",
    low_memory=False,
    dtype={"id": "Int64", "host_id": "Int64"},
)

# 2. Inspect original dataset
display(bnb.head())            # 在 Jupyter 中预览表格
print(bnb.columns.tolist())    # 对应 names(bnb)
bnb.info()                     # 查看列类型和非空数量

display(bnb.iloc[:15, :8])     # 前 15 行、前 8 列

selected_columns = [
    # Location
    "latitude",
    "longitude",
    "neighbourhood_cleansed",

    # Listing and host
    "id",
    "host_id",
    "host_location",
    "license",
    "room_type",
    "property_type",

    # Price and estimated activity
    "price",
    "estimated_occupancy_l365d",
    "estimated_revenue_l365d",

    # Calendar availability
    "availability_90",
    "availability_365",
]

bnb_clean = bnb.loc[:, selected_columns].copy()

# Convert values such as "$1,250.00" to 1250.0
bnb_clean["price"] = pd.to_numeric(
    bnb_clean["price"].astype("string").str.replace(r"[$£,]", "", regex=True),
    errors="coerce",
)

# Check the selected columns and their missing values
display(bnb_clean.head())
display(bnb_clean.isna().sum().rename("missing_count").to_frame())
```

adding them to the map , we have this initial mapping of our concernec values.
https://data.insideairbnb.com/united-kingdom/england/london/2026-09-17/visualisations/neighbourhoods.geojson


We use the 19 June 2026 Inside Airbnb London to count visible entire-home listings by borough. 
We identify entire-home listings using room_type and count each unique listing id once. We classify a host account as multi-listing if its host_id is associated with at least two distinct entire-home listings across London. Borough-level dwelling stock will allow us to report listing counts per 1,000 dwellings.

```{python}


# Keep one row per visible entire-home listing
entire_homes = (
    bnb_clean.loc[
        bnb_clean["room_type"].eq("Entire home/apt"),
        ["id", "host_id", "neighbourhood_cleansed"],
    ]
    .dropna(subset=["id"])
    .drop_duplicates(subset="id")
    .copy()
)

# Count each account's entire-home listings across all of London
entire_homes["host_listing_count"] = (
    entire_homes.groupby("host_id")["id"].transform("size")
)

# Flag listings associated with an account that has at least two entire homes
entire_homes["host_identified"] = entire_homes["host_id"].notna()
entire_homes["multi_listing_host"] = (
    entire_homes["host_listing_count"].ge(2)
)

# Summarise the listings by borough
borough_summary = (
    entire_homes.dropna(subset=["neighbourhood_cleansed"])
    .groupby("neighbourhood_cleansed", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        listing_count=("id", "size"),
        listings_with_host_id=("host_identified", "sum"),
        multi_host_listing_count=("multi_listing_host", "sum"),
    )
)

borough_summary["multi_host_listing_pct"] = (
    borough_summary["multi_host_listing_count"]
    .div(borough_summary["listings_with_host_id"].replace(0, float("nan")))
    .mul(100)
)

print("Unique entire-home listings across London:", len(entire_homes))
print("Listings without a borough:", entire_homes["neighbourhood_cleansed"].isna().sum())
print("Listings without a host ID:", entire_homes["host_id"].isna().sum())

display(borough_summary.sort_values("listing_count", ascending=False).head(10))



```

```{python}
```{python}
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

boroughs_url = (
    "https://data.insideairbnb.com/united-kingdom/england/london/"
    "2026-09-17/visualisations/neighbourhoods.geojson"
)
boroughs = gpd.read_file(boroughs_url)

london_map = boroughs.merge(
    borough_summary,
    left_on="neighbourhood",
    right_on="neighbourhood_cleansed",
    how="left",
    validate="one_to_one",
)

expected = borough_summary["listing_count"].sum()
mapped = london_map["listing_count"].sum()
print(f"Listings represented on the map: {mapped:,.0f} / {expected:,.0f}")

if mapped != expected:
    unmatched = set(borough_summary["neighbourhood_cleansed"]) - set(
        boroughs["neighbourhood"]
    )
    raise ValueError(f"Borough names missing from the map: {sorted(unmatched)}")

london_map["listing_count"] = london_map["listing_count"].fillna(0).astype(int)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 8))
london_map.to_crs(27700).plot(
    column="listing_count",
    cmap="BuPu",
    legend=True,
    edgecolor="white",
    linewidth=0.5,
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Entire-home Airbnb listings by London borough\n19 June 2026")
ax.set_axis_off()

fig.savefig("london_airbnb_boroughs.png", dpi=160, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
